STEP 14. Check connectors C-28 at intermediate 
connector and C-107 at junction block for damage.
Q: Are the connectors in good condition?
YES : Repair it because of harness open circuit or short 
circuit to ground between input shaft speed sensor 
connector B-42 terminal 3 and junction block 
connector C-107 terminal 12.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
STEP 15. Replace the input shaft speed sensor.
(1) Replace the input shaft speed sensor. Refer to GROUP 
23B, Transaxle P.23B-11.
(2) Carry out a test drive.
(3) Read in the diagnostic trouble code.
Q: Is the A/T diagnostic trouble code number "22" output?
YES : Go to Step 16.
NO : The inspection is complete.
